description: Boundary cases both languages build from a recipe, because the payload is too large to store.

cases.name: typed value exactly at the 32 KiB cap
cases.reason: 32768 bytes of canonical JSON is the limit, not one byte less

cases.name: typed value one byte over the cap
cases.reason: a TypedValue is at most 32 KiB of canonical JSON

cases.name: request that fills the 64 KiB envelope exactly
cases.reason: 65536 bytes including the envelope wrapper is admissible

cases.name: request one byte past the envelope ceiling
cases.reason: the complete envelope must fit Flybus's 64-KiB maximum

cases.name: error message of 512 astral code points
cases.reason: the bound counts code points, not UTF-16 units or bytes

cases.name: error message of 513 astral code points
cases.reason: the bound counts code points, not UTF-16 units or bytes

recipes.padded-typed-value: a TypedValue whose schema is padSchema and whose value is {"pad": <padCharacters> 'a' characters}; validate it
recipes.padded-request: a SessionRpcRequest req-1 with scope null and params {"pad": <padCharacters> 'a' characters}; canonicalize it, then require the envelope to fit with an overhead of envelopeTotal minus that canonical length
recipes.error-message: a SessionRpcFailure with code INTERNAL, mutation unknown and a message of <codePoints> 'x' characters
recipes.error-message-astral: the same failure with a message of <codePoints> repetitions of U+10400, one code point and two UTF-16 units each
